desc: NILOS SPACER RING TYPE A (EXTERNALLY SEALING)
tech: The various types of NILOS Spacer- Ring depend on the relevant shaft or housing diameter. They can be used for almost all types of NILOS Rings for inner and outer sealing with the exception of the series 618, 619 and AK rings. The width of the spacer ring prevents any jamming of the NILOS-Ring in the groove of the locking ring and installation pliers cannot collide with the bevelling on the NILOS-Ring. The material is a form of die-cast zinc. The usable temperature range under heavy loading is 100 °C max.

desc: LABYRINTH METAL OIL SEALS-L SERIES
tech: Type- L Labyrinth seals are a type of non-contact seal that uses a tortuous path of grooves or chambers to restrict fluid flow and prevent leakage. These seals are commonly used in rotating equipment to prevent contamination and leakage, particularly in environments with dust, sand, or splashing liquids. They are known for their non-contact design, which minimizes friction and wear. Features are :  Long life, Low friction, Non-contact design, Effective sealing, Versatile. Applications : They are suitable for various applications, including those with high speeds, moderate to high temperatures, and where contamination is a concern.  L : These seals have a labyrinth path that can be either a sawtooth pattern or a special winding path.

DL :  Labyrinth seals, which are known for their free-rotating design and suitability for fast-rotating machinery.

desc: EXCLUDER SEALS FOR TAPERED ROLLER BEARINGS
tech: This Seal to be Used with (CONE) X32217 & (CUP) Y32217. The CSL Premium seal combines the benefits of a machined metal and elastomer. The elastomer covers the outside face and seals against thehousing bore for maximum protection. The CSL Premium seal has a nose gasket that seals against the cupfront face. The SAE lip design reduces drag, increases seal life, excludes heavy contaminants, and allows spent grease to be flushed from the bearing cavity. The lead-in chamfer allows for easy, accurate installation and better concentricity between the housing bore and the sealing lip. CSL Premium seals are used in corrosive environments such as cargo handling equipment, drilling rigs, mine-car wheels, shjpboard applications,hospital equipment, recreation equipment and utility trailers.

They are designed to prevent dirt and debris from entering the bearing cavity. Spent grease can be flushed from the bearing cavity, promoting extended bearing life. The CST is a grease flushing seal with a rubber covered seal face which has a rubber ridge that seals against the housing radius to protect the bearing in a corrosive environment. The metal O.D. provides a heavy press fit with a nose seal for added O.D. sealing.

desc: EXCLUDER SEALS FOR TAPERED ROLLER BEARINGS
tech: This Seal to be Used with (CONE) 25590 & (CUP) 25520. The CQ is a grease retaining seal for vertical shaft applications. The steel case is clamped between the cone back face and the shaft shoulder. The seal can be rubber covered on the air side unless heavy clamping pressure precludes using rubber or where space is limited. The sealing lip contacts the cup front face. These seals are specially designed to retain grease in the bottom bearing of vertical shaft applications. Rubber on the seal I.D. provides a positive seal against the shaft. It is used in the rotary table of drilling rigs. This seal was originally designed to retain grease in the upper bearing of the vertical shaft in a large gear box where the bearing had failed due to the lack of lubrication.

desc: EXCLUDER SEALS 6000 SERIES
tech: This Seal to be Used with (CONE) NA56425SW & (CUP) 56650D. The 6000 series seals are used in applications where excessive thrust load (fleet angle) could exceed the press fit of the bearing  cup in the housing (sheave) bore. A machined metal ring provides a shoulder to positively retain the cup. The 6000 series seal is designed to work with the machined ring to retain bearing grease and provide maximum protection from contaminants. The 6000 series Sheave Seal is available in CA, CE, and CS types. These seals are used on marine docks and aboard ships where the heavy loads swivel and shift.

desc: NON-CONTACT LABYRINTH METAL SEALS
tech: CF labyrinth metal seals, specifically those manufactured by GMN, are high-efficiency, non-contact seals designed for spindle bearings. They offer 100% sealing efficiency against splashing liquids, both when the spindle is rotating and stationary. These seals are characterized by their compact design, quick and easy installation (often without needing to rebuild the spindle), and the ability to be installed directly against the bearing, saving space in the spindle design. Features are : Space Saving, Easy Installation, Compact Size, High Speed Capability, Load Transfer. Materials : CF seals are typically made from nitriding steel, which is hardened and face-ground.

desc: Garlock KLOZURE Model 64 Oil Seal
tech: Garlock's KLOZURE Model 64 Oil Seal with a MILL-RIGHT V lip offers up to 92% improvement in abrasion resistance and greater temperature resistance than standard nitrile seals translating to higher equipment efficiencies, longer bearing life, increased production, and less maintenance. MILL-RIGHT V has been specifically engineered to have the highest chemical resistance and temperature capability available in the MILL-RIGHT family. This seal is a great option for high-speed rotary applications with extreme shaft misalignment. Boasting the industry's highest shaft-to-bore misalignment ratings and one of the fastest shaft speed ratings, the Model 64 Oil Seal can solve the most difficult bearing protection problems. Unlike bonded seals where the rubber to metal bond can fail, resulting in leaks and lack of bearing protection, the Model 64 seal performance is assured with our unique assembled combination of a sealing element, heavy duty metal case, metal filler ring, and brass insert with a special interlocked garter and finger spring. For optimal performance requiring less misalignment, or with frequent chock removal and installation consider KLOZURE® Model 59. For applications requiring minimal misalignment, consider KLOZURE® Model 53.

desc: DOUBLE LIP SEAL (CLOSED)
tech: The SM series from Harhues & Teufert is a closed, double-lip seal for linear applications. Its primary function is to protect linear bearings by preventing contaminants from entering and keeping lubricant inside. The double-lip design provides a more effective and robust barrier against dirt and dust compared to a single-lip version. It is used with linear ball bearings to prevent the ingress of external contaminants, such as dust, dirt, and debris, which could damage the rolling elements. It also helps retain the internal lubricant required for the bearing\'s smooth operation. Material : The seal is typically constructed from high-quality, oil-resistant synthetic rubber, such as NBR, to provide long-lasting performance and chemical resistance. Features are : Contaminant Protection, Lubricant Retention, Wear Resistance, Operational longevity, Accommodation of misalignment. Applications : Factory automation, CNC machines and precision machining, Medical and laboratory equipment, Packaging and converting equipment, Heavy-duty machinery, Material handling systems.

desc: DOUBLE LIP SEALING RING (SLOTTED)

desc: SEALING RINGS
tech: The Nadella DH series is a sealing ring (or end cap) designed to work with a corresponding needle roller bearing assembly, rather than a bearing itself. Its function is to seal the open end of a drawn cup needle bush, retaining lubricant and protecting the internal components from contaminants. The DH sealing rings have the same inner and outer dimensions as Nadella needle bushes and the radial portion of combined bearings type RAX 700, ensuring a proper fit within the standard housing bore. It creates an effective contact seal (lip seal) to prevent lubricant from escaping and to block the ingress of dust, moisture, and debris. Material: Made in synthetic rubber and incorporates a metal insert. Features are : High Speed Capability, Low Friction, Contamination Protection, Lubricant Retention, Installation Tooling. Applications : Textile Machinery, Automotive Systems, Industrial Gearboxes & Transmissions, Pumps & Compressors, Agricultural Equipment, Precision Robotics & Automation, Machine Tools, Printing Presses.

desc: SEALILNG RINGS
tech: The Nadella ET series is a radial seal ring used to protect needle roller bearings from contaminants. It is part of the Nadella ET series of radial seals. This series designed to provide effective sealing for needle roller bearings, preventing dirt, dust, and other contaminants from entering the bearing assembly. The seal features a flexible elastomer lip that maintains contact with the rotating shaft or a corresponding inner ring surface, while the sheet steel reinforcement provides structural integrity and ensures a secure fit in the housing bore. Material : Sheet steel-reinforced elastomer. Features are : Effective Contamination Protection, Ease of Installation, Low Friction and Wear, Compact Design, Cost-Effective Maintenance, Corrosion Protection. Applications : Gearboxes and Transmissions, Machine Tools, Pumps, Compressors, and Turbines, Textile and Printing Machines, Mixers and Kneading Machines, Agricultural and Construction Machinery, Precision and Automation Equipment, Electric Motors.
